calibration.benchmark_usage: Temperatures were fitted on 2568 categorical native-validation examples before bench-v4 inference. No bench-v4 labels were used in fitting. Positive per-type temperature scaling preserves argmax accuracy but affects probability-based calibration metrics.
calibration.data_availability: The native-validation inputs, references, prediction records and original fitting script are not published with this submission. Independent reproduction of the temperature fit is therefore unavailable; hashes of these unavailable artifacts are omitted.
calibration.method: Per-type temperature scaling: minimize mean NLL over 81 logarithmically spaced temperatures in [0.25, 16], plus 1.
calibration.prompt_policy: Refitted for read_twice=true with read_twice_max_input_tokens=4096 and the exact-context guard, matching this benchmark request profile. These are not the model package calibration.json temperatures, which apply to standard prompts.

calibration_overlap_audit.evidence_availability: Author-reported exact-match audit. The native-validation material is not published here, so this audit cannot be independently verified from this submission.
calibration_overlap_audit.method: Exact comparison after JSON canonicalization, whitespace normalization and Unicode casefolding: full request state/context and every source-state string leaf of at least 160 characters. No inference about paraphrases or semantic overlap.

confidence_semantics: Runtime choice confidence measures excess of the highest probability above the uniform baseline, normalized to [0, 1]. The benchmark derives confidence from native probabilities using the unchanged scorer.
latency_basis: Self-hosted A100, loopback; public network excluded.
